mapper.sql:
sample.stable_id AS "${prefix}sampleId", patient.stable_id AS "${prefix}patientId", resource_sample.RESOURCE_ID AS "${prefix}resourceId", cancer_study.cancer_study_identifier AS "${prefix}studyId"
, resource_sample.URL AS "${prefix}url"
,

patient.stable_id AS "${prefix}patientId", resource_patient.RESOURCE_ID AS "${prefix}resourceId", cancer_study.cancer_study_identifier AS "${prefix}studyId"
, resource_patient.URL AS "${prefix}url"
,

resource_study.RESOURCE_ID AS "${prefix}resourceId", cancer_study.cancer_study_identifier AS "${prefix}studyId"
, resource_study.URL AS "${prefix}url"
,

FROM (SELECT RESOURCE_ID, CANCER_STUDY_ID, SAMPLE_ID, URL FROM resource_data WHERE ENTITY_TYPE = 'SAMPLE' AND SAMPLE_ID IS NOT NULL) AS resource_sample INNER JOIN cancer_study ON resource_sample.CANCER_STUDY_ID = cancer_study.cancer_study_id INNER JOIN sample ON sample.stable_id = resource_sample.SAMPLE_ID INNER JOIN patient ON sample.patient_id = patient.internal_id AND patient.cancer_study_id = resource_sample.CANCER_STUDY_ID

FROM (SELECT RESOURCE_ID, CANCER_STUDY_ID, PATIENT_ID, URL FROM resource_data WHERE ENTITY_TYPE = 'PATIENT' AND PATIENT_ID IS NOT NULL) AS resource_patient INNER JOIN cancer_study ON resource_patient.CANCER_STUDY_ID = cancer_study.cancer_study_id INNER JOIN patient ON patient.stable_id = resource_patient.PATIENT_ID AND patient.cancer_study_id = resource_patient.CANCER_STUDY_ID

FROM (SELECT RESOURCE_ID, CANCER_STUDY_ID, URL FROM resource_data WHERE ENTITY_TYPE = 'STUDY') AS resource_study INNER JOIN cancer_study ON resource_study.CANCER_STUDY_ID = cancer_study.cancer_study_id
